summary: Read the NAS address and the DSM login from `~/.claude/printing-press/<cli-name>/.env`, one directory per printing-press CLI, sitting between the config file and the real environment.
reason: DSM has no API key: a login is an account plus a password, and `session login` only persists the resulting session id and SynoToken. Without a credential file there is nowhere for the password to live, so an expired session cannot renew itself unattended and the operator has to either re-login by hand or export the password into a shell profile, where every child process inherits it. A dotfile the CLI reads directly keeps the password off the command line and out of the environment. The file lives at `~/.claude/printing-press/<cli-name>/.env`, one directory per printing-press CLI rather than one flat file for all of them: the variable names each CLI reads are its own, so a single file would collide as soon as two CLIs wanted the same key. `internal/config/dotenv.go` adds `applyDotenv(cfg)`, called from `config.Load()` right after `snapshotFileConfig()`, plus the exported `DotenvLookup`. Precedence weakest first: credentials file, `.env`, real environment variables. Only `BaseURL` and `InsecureTLS` are filled into `Config`; the account, password, OTP code and device identifiers are resolved per field through `DotenvLookup` in `dsmCredentialsFromEnv` instead, so the password never enters `Config`, never reaches `snapshotFileConfig`, and can never be written back by `save()`. No `os.Setenv` anywhere, because this CLI spawns subprocesses that would inherit it. Loose permissions on the file are reported, not silently tightened: the file belongs to the operator, not to this CLI. The warning names it a password rather than a token on purpose - a DSM account password is usually the same login that administers the whole NAS, so the blast radius is larger than a scoped, revocable API token.
coverage_impact: No command surface, flag or output shape changed. One new credential source that is skipped entirely when the file is absent.
validated_outcome: `go build ./...` clean and all five tests in `internal/config` covering the new code pass.
